title: Workspace with an open project
caption: The Acme Notes project open in the workspace: project tab, views sidebar, and the queue of tickets read from the project's checkout through the bridge and server.
shows: Real app with a real ticket server and Git ticket store, seeded with ten synthetic tickets of mixed category, priority, and status.

title: Ticket editor with notes
caption: One ticket selected: the inspector edits its fields and details and lists its notes, including an attributed AI planning note.
shows: Inspector scrolled to the Notes section of the featured ticket; a human note and an AI 'Preliminary thoughts' note written through the server API.

title: AI session terminal
caption: The project terminal drawer attached to a running AI session's PTY over the terminal WebSocket, with replay and live output.
shows: A real server-hosted PTY reported as a connected Codex session; the transcript is synthetic text printed by the fixture command, not a real AI tool.

title: AI question prompt
caption: A question the AI session asked arrives in the app as a prompt the user can answer here or in the terminal.
shows: The 'AI waiting for your answer' prompt raised by the real server from a synthetic Codex rollout record.

title: Orchestration plan and run
caption: The Orchestration view: a goal's planned steps by column, the running step dispatched to a worker, and the inspector's Where It Runs, Plan, and Run sections.
shows: A real orchestration project with a bound target, a two-step readiness plan, and one dispatched run, all created through the server's orchestration API.

title: Remote device pairing request
caption: A browser asks to pair with this host: a notice announces it, Settings carries the count, and Devices lists the waiting request to approve or reject.
shows: Real app and ticket server; the host's device-management list and the anonymous pairing_requests change event are synthetic route answers in the server's shapes.

title: Project ticket sources
caption: Project settings list the ticket sources this checkout uses; GitHub, GitLab, and Jira sign-ins are shared app-wide under Accounts.
shows: The real provider list from the server, with the store's temporary folder replaced by a portable display path.

title: Adding a ticket source
caption: Adding a source offers a Hot Sheet Git ticket repository or a native GitHub Issues, GitLab Issues, or Jira Cloud connection, each keeping its own authoritative records.
shows: The real 'Set up ticket support' dialog opened from Ticket sources.

title: Standby display
caption: Standby shows every open project's live activity at a glance: token rate, tickets updated, and a stalled-work alert.
shows: The in-app standby screen over the real app; the live-state snapshot for two synthetic stores is a route answer in the server's GET /live-state shape.
